_comment: Plain-language 'You can / You cannot yet' lists for the front page. tools/site_status.py renders them into website/index.html (between the site-status markers) and checks the area names in 'matrix' against docs/FEATURE-MATRIX.md. Keep the wording honest: this is the offline Theme Park World game; Theme Park Inc is a later goal.

can.text: Start from the original CD launcher, watch the intro movies and walk into the 3D lobby.
Pick any of the four worlds (Lost Kingdom, Wonder Land, Space Zone, Halloween World) and build a park there, or open the jungle sandbox with --sandbox.
Place any of the 274 original rides, shops, sideshows and features; they run their original scripts and animations.

Run a park with guests, staff, money, loans, research, objectives, golden tickets and keys, and save it and resume it later (the app and the browser); a park in play is also autosaved every five minutes.
Build your own roller coaster: pylons, closed circuits, original cost, rating and train motion.
Build go-kart and water ride tracks and add their jumps, tunnels and the Space Racers teleport from the ride's upgrade list.
Hear the advisor, the park music and nearly every ride, weather, guest, staff and interface sound, and play the game in nine languages at any resolution.

Build swimming pools with changing rooms, slides, spas, a lazy river and swimming guests: the pools extension is on by default, with its own models, textures and guest animations (switch it off under Options, OpenTPW, Extensions and mods).
Change the game with mods: data mods, sandboxed TPW Script mods for guest decisions (desktop), the official extensions and local texture packs you build from your own copy.
Go online: publish and visit parks and walk around them with the other visitors, vote, send postcards and chat, on the official server or your own.

cannot.text: Load an original save game completely: its staff, research, ride scripts and most guests load, but guests in queues, on rides, held by guards, walking to the arrival vehicle or standing off the paths are dropped, a roller coaster loads with its track and trains but without its riders, and the guests' animation scripts, the ride scripts' saved object animation and a few other blocks are not restored.
matrix: Versioned saves and original read-only import

cannot.text: Hear every sound exactly: the stereo pan of a positioned sound, the order in which equally loud voices keep their place and the rounding of a fade still follow documented approximations (the room reverb is OpenTPW's own by design, because the original's lives in the sound card).
matrix: Audio, music, video and first-person/ride cameras

cannot.text: Build a park together with other players: a shared park is a snapshot, and its visitors walk it together but cannot change it.
Rely on the original's exact numbers everywhere: some rules still use a documented approximation.

later: Full Theme Park Inc / Sim Coaster support is a later goal. The experimental building-and-guests slice can already start with your own files in the browser or through the desktop world command. Campaign, economy, staff, advisor and native park saves remain unavailable. The desktop edition chooser (--setup) is part of the releases since v0.8.0.
